title: Implement and verify the two-stage WACA-SE module
rawGoal: I want to reproduce WACA, but I do not know where to begin.
objective: Implement a bounded WACA-SE module and verify that Stage 2 learns from the weak-feature tensor produced by Stage 1.

deliverables.description: Shape, gradient, parameter-sharing, and Stage 2 semantic tests

acceptanceCriteria.description: The module preserves input shape and produces finite outputs and gradients.

evidenceRequirements.description: A runtime test checks shape, output finiteness, and gradient finiteness.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Stage 2 receives Xweak rather than the original X or Stage 1 descriptor.

evidenceRequirements.description: Source inspection identifies the tensor supplied to the shared MLP in Stage 2.
A semantic test captures and compares the actual Stage 2 input with Xweak.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Stage 1 and Stage 2 use the same MLP parameters.

evidenceRequirements.description: Source inspection confirms that both stages call one shared MLP instance.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Generate an optional visualization of both attention masks.

evidenceRequirements.description: An inspected visualization artifact is available.

known: The input and output shapes are both [B, C, H, W].
Both attention stages must share one MLP.
unknowns: Whether the paper specifies a fixed or learnable fusion coefficient.
assumptions: The demonstration uses a fixed fusion coefficient of 0.5.

evidenceItems.summary: The submitted log reports that shape, finite-output, and finite-gradient tests passed.
Static inspection finds Stage 2 reuses Stage 1 information instead of Xweak.
The forward-hook comparison fails because the Stage 2 input does not match Xweak.
Both stages call the same shared MLP object.
